name: Nexus Cybernetics & Gadget Lab
bio: Harare's premier boutique for precision electronics, wearable tech, tactical EDC gadgets, and audiophile gear. All inventory verified authentic with official local warranty and instant WhatsApp concierge support.
address: Shop 14, Avondale Tech Hub, King George Rd, Harare

blocks.tagline: Next-gen electronics, tactical EDC gear & high-fidelity audio hardware
blocks.hero: Curated performance tech, unboxed and bench-tested before dispatch. From audiophile wireless acoustics to 140W GaN power stations and 4K aerial drones — order directly on WhatsApp with same-day express delivery across Harare.
blocks.services:
Official 12-Month Hardware Warranty
Bench Testing & Live Unboxing Demo
Direct WhatsApp Technical Concierge
Same-Day Harare Express Dispatch
Trade-in & Hardware Upgrade Lab

faq.q: Are all gadgets brand new and genuine?
faq.a: Yes, 100% authentic sealed hardware sourced directly from verified regional distributors with manufacturer serial verification.

faq.q: How does instant WhatsApp ordering work?
faq.a: Select any gadget and your desired quantity, then tap 'Order on WhatsApp'. Your chat is preloaded with product specs and SKU. Our technician confirms payment details and delivery immediately.

faq.q: What warranty and after-sales support do you provide?
faq.a: Every item includes our 12-month local replacement warranty. If a defect occurs, bring it in or courier it back for instant repair or replacement.
We offer same-day express courier dispatch in Harare (within 2-4 hours) and reliable overnight freight to Bulawayo, Mutare, Gweru and Victoria Falls.

testimonials.comment: The CyberPulse ANC headphones arrived sealed within 3 hours in Borrowdale. Sound stage is unreal and the WhatsApp concierge walked me through the EQ app.
